claims.statement: Version deletion UI differs by package type: containers use the version menu then Delete version; other package types use Delete next to the version. This fragment omits authorization, confirmation and recovery conditions; it cannot authorize deletion or prove successful removal. Screenshot captions were read, not images inspected.

Organization packages are reached from the organization's main page through the Packages tab. The example organization and screenshot caption are illustrative, not an owned target, complete package inventory or observed access.

Personal packages are reached through the personal profile, profile-picture Your profile menu and Packages tab. This navigation does not establish an account identity, package ownership, permission or inventory; the screenshot caption is not visual verification.

The package access step uses Invite teams or people under Manage access or Inherited access and accepts a person's name, username or email. It does not define granted role, eligibility, acceptance, inherited effects or verified identity; no invitation or grant was made.

FPT/GHEC version management uses View and manage all versions under Recent Versions. GHES containers use the same path, while GHES noncontainers use Package settings then Manage versions. Branch/type-specific navigation is not complete census, permission or deletion evidence; image captions were not image inspection.

The settings step selects a package and opens Package settings on its landing page. This supplies UI navigation only, not actual permission, observed configuration or authority to change settings; its screenshot remains uninspected.
